message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, contemporary, and cult‑favorite horror films across several sub‑genres. Pick whatever fits your mood—whether you’re after psychological dread, supernatural chills, or gore‑heavy thrills.

| # | Title (Year) | Sub‑genre / Notable Element | Quick Hook |
|---|--------------|-----------------------------|------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** (1960) | Psychological thriller | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense and the iconic shower scene. |
| 2 | **The Shining** (1980) | Gothic/psychological horror | A family isolated in a haunted hotel with Jack Nicholson’s unforgettable descent into madness. |
| 3 | **The Exorcist** (1973) | Supernatural possession | One of the most chilling exorcism stories ever filmed. |
| 4 | **Halloween** (1978) | Slasher | John Carpenter’s seminal slasher featuring Michael Myers. |
| 5 | **A Nightmare on Elm Street** (1984) | Dream‑based supernatural | Freddy Krueger haunts teenagers in their sleep. |
| 6 | **The Ring** (2002) | Modern supernatural | A cursed videotape that kills anyone who watches it within seven days. |
| 7 | **Hereditary** (2018) | Family‑driven supernatural | A family’s dark secrets unravel in a terrifying, atmospheric way. |
| 8 | **Get Out** (2017) | Horror‑comedy/social satire | A Black man visits his white girlfriend’s family estate, uncovering a sinister plot. |
| 9 | **It Follows** (2014) | Creepy, slow‑burn | A curse passed through sexual contact that relentlessly stalks its victims. |
|10 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Folk horror | A daylight festival in Sweden turns deadly for an American couple. |
|11 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological horror | A mother and son confront a malevolent entity from a children’s book. |
|12 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Paranormal investigation | Real‑life paranormal investigators Ed & Lorraine Warren tackle a haunted house. |
|13 | **Saw** (2004) | Gore‑heavy, puzzle‑style | Two strangers awaken in a locked room with a twisted game of survival. |
|14 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Found‑footage realism | Home video footage captures a haunting that escalates over months. |
|15 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (2012) | Meta‑horror | A group of friends at a remote cabin triggers a ritualistic horror machine. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a particular era, sub‑genre, or if you’re looking for something more obscure!
